events.summary: We are streaming a looped recording of Dungeon Sookuma during Steam Next Fest. This broadcast includes trailers, game overviews, and demo gameplay replays. Please note that this is a pre-recorded video, not a live stream. You can download the demo directly from the store page to play it yourself.

events.title: Save Sookuma! Early-Game Survival Hotfix for the Baby Bear
events.summary: Wah, save me! Hi, I'm Sookuma. The early dungeon has been so spicy lately—I kept collapsing to ranged mobs and Needle Rats, went whole runs without ever seeing a shop, and even got trapped while trying to escape, which really brought tears to my eyes! This hotfix doesn't add new dungeons, classes, or spells, but it's a balance and bug-fix patch to save me from constantly falling over and to nicely tune the feel of weapons, bows, and magic! events.title: Sight, Sound & Smack Update! 37 Spells Reborn
events.summary: Boom, crack, smack! Sight, Sound, and Smack—spell visual effects, audio, and hit impact have all been totally reborn! Hi, I'm Sookuma! We didn't add new spells, dungeons, classes, or monsters, but we completely remade what was already there so you can see it, hear it, and feel it right in your hands! events.title: Resistances Stack in Tiers, New Dream Resistance, and Armor Resistance Brands
events.summary: Hi, it's Sookuma! This time, I've prepared an update that reworks the dungeon's resistance system and adds the new Dream element. I also took another look through the death logs players sent to the Death Gallery (no names or personal info, of course). Before, wearing just a single piece of resistance gear would cut damage in half and block almost every status condition, but now resistances stack step by step into Tier 1 and Tier 2. events.title: Catch Your Breath, Unleash Your Power
events.summary: Hey there, it's Sookuma! I've tuned the dungeon so you can catch your breath more comfortably and unleash the powers of the gods much more freely with your faith. From spells and combat controls to elite monsters, save data, and replays, here are the key changes in this update! Changes to Recovery and Faith Natural recovery now scales with maximum HP and mana. events.title: Come Play in My Dream Dungeon! The Dungeon Sookuma Demo Is Here
events.summary: Hi! I'm Sookuma, a little bear cub. The Dungeon Sookuma demo is finally here! You can get it free on Steam right now. I'm so excited to finally invite you into the dream dungeon I visit every night. Come play in my dream dungeon Dungeon Sookuma is a traditional turn-based roguelike where I, Sookuma the bear cub, venture into a dream dungeon that changes every night.
